text: {"bull":["Annual revenue grew from ₹12,192 cr in FY23 to ₹48,873 cr in FY26, a nearly 300% increase over three years, indicating strong top‑line expansion.","Operating profit rose from ₹519 cr in FY23 to ₹1,873 cr in FY26, more than tripling and reflecting improving profitability despite macro pressures.","Management highlighted a negative five‑day working‑capital cycle and ROCE of 34.1% in Q1 FY27, suggesting efficient capital use and high returns on invested capital.","The company is expanding backward‑integration capacity, with camera module production slated to increase from 70 million to up to 190 million units annually, potentially enhancing margins."],"bear":["Operating margin fell to 3.0% in Q2 FY27 from 3.8% in Q2 FY26, indicating margin compression after the expiry of Mobile PLI 1 and higher input costs.","Net profit showed volatility, dropping to ₹280 cr in Q2 FY26 from ₹465 cr in Q1 FY26, and again falling to ₹321 cr in Q4 FY25, reflecting earnings instability.","Q4 FY26 revenue was flat at ₹10,520 cr year‑on‑year, and the quarter’s PAT fell to ₹192 cr, underscoring short‑term demand weakness and geopolitical headwinds.","The stock trades at a forward P/E of 42.4, implying high valuation relative to earnings and potential downside if growth slows."]}
